projects.status: An actively developed, released tool with working capture/resume functionality and substantial offline-tested features; several live-use paths are explicitly unverified. 'Memory experiment' is an honest profile framing; 'production-proven memory platform' is not.

concrete_evidence: README describes a redacted local chat inbox, deterministic resume briefs and a separate private Markdown wiki in git.
Internal inbox source implements redacted append-only JSONL capture.
Verification docs report successful synthetic recall checks in Claude Code CLI and Codex CLI, including cross-host recall, clear and compaction; Claude desktop checks are narrower.
Public release 2026.11.6 has arm64/amd64 macOS binaries, install/uninstall scripts, licenses and SHA256SUMS.
README and verification docs explicitly say no live wiki update has run yet; desktop recall, daily maintenance, MCP and other paths still need live checks.

macOS is the supported runtime; Linux CI keeping code building is not Linux runtime support.
